purpose: Two monitors, one writer. Whoever takes over after 180 min of primary silence becomes the primary (sticky takeover, owner decision 10.10.2026).
reason: Owner 13.10.2026 (~23:55 MSK): 'пускай робот всё делает' — the GitHub robot becomes the telemetry writer without the 1–2 day parallel check. ChatGPT is the standby (read-only while the robot is healthy; takes over by the sticky rule after 180 min without a verified healthy robot cycle). Claude monitor stays off.

robot.title: GitHub robot (topview-robot.yml + scripts/robot_telemetry.py)
robot.schedule: every 10 minutes, started by Supabase pg_cron (ops/ROBOT-TRIGGER.md)
robot.mode_variable: ROBOT_TELEMETRY=on (default when the variable is absent) | shadow (kill switch)
robot.status: on (13.10.2026, owner): primary writer; ROBOT_TELEMETRY defaults to on, set the variable to 'shadow' to stop it

switch_command: Owner says 'основной монитор — Claude' or 'основной монитор — ChatGPT'. Any agent then swaps primary/standby, sets set_at to the real time, commits this file.
rules: Before any write each monitor runs: python3 scripts/monitor_role.py . --me <claude|chatgpt>.

run -> full cycle as primary; skip -> no writes at all; failover -> the script has already made you primary in monitor-role.json: run a full cycle, commit monitor-role.json with it, cycle note 'takeover from <old primary>', tell the owner once.

Automatic takeover: after 180 minutes without a verified completed primary cycle, the standby takes over and BECOMES the primary (owner decision 10.10.2026). There is no automatic return; the old primary is now the standby and takes over back only if the new primary is silent for 180 minutes.
Nobody writes if the other monitor committed within collision_guard_minutes.
The owner can still set the primary by command ('основной монитор — Claude / ChatGPT'): any agent swaps primary/standby, sets set_by=owner and set_at, commits.

ChatGPT is owner-authorized as writer and is now the STANDBY (owner 13.10.2026: the GitHub robot is the primary). While the robot is healthy ChatGPT only reads (skip); it takes over only by the 180-minute sticky rule. A background successful cycle must never be fabricated.

The GitHub robot is a third named writer (13.10.2026) and the primary since the owner's decision 13.10.2026. It runs real telemetry only while primary == robot AND ROBOT_TELEMETRY != shadow (default on); it never takes over by silence. If the robot is primary and has no VERIFIED healthy cycle for 180 minutes, the standby takes over by the usual sticky rule; the robot then stays silent until an owner command makes it primary again.
